decisions.reason: This naval vessel lighting system fits the firm's established specialist-lighting and demanding-environment capabilities, and its continued website presence suggests the firm sees enough learning and commercial value to retain it.

As a general interior lighting luminaire, C is close to the firm's core knowledge base and easy to improve through its existing engineering and testing resources, though it looks less strategically prominent than some other lines.

D matches the firm's stated move toward advanced application-focused lighting and was presented as a flagship release, so a large R&D-capable firm is very likely to keep developing rather than withdraw it.

This marine searchlight remains sufficiently related to the firm's robust specialist-lighting business and has stayed on the website after launch, indicating the firm can absorb market feedback and continue supporting it.
